structure.unit: Organization, Admission and Licensing of Insurers

law.catch_line: Felony for State Treasurer to dispose of securities illegally
law.text: If the State Treasurer disposes of any securities deposited with him under this title, other than as provided in this title, he shall be guilty of a Class 3 felony, and, upon conviction, shall be punished by a fine double the amount of the disposed securities.
